dashboard.label: Discovery Inventory
dashboard.description: CMDB-oriented subnet-discovery evidence from Ping Monitor v5.10+. “Not observed” means only that an IP did not answer that discovery scan; it is not a health, outage, or decommissioning conclusion.

search.query: | inputlookup ping_monitor_settings_lookup | search _key="global" | head 1 | append [| makeresults | eval index="ping", sourcetype="ping_monitor"] | head 1 | eval pm_index=if(isnull(index) OR index=="", "ping", index) | eval pm_sourcetype=if(isnull(sourcetype) OR sourcetype=="", "ping_monitor", sourcetype)
`ping_discovery_events($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | where isnotnull(target_network) AND target_network!="" | stats count by target_network | fields target_network | sort target_network

choice.value: Not observed in latest applicable scan

html.p: Signal interpretation: Discovery proves that an address answered an ICMP subnet scan at a point in time. “Not observed” is retained as evidence, but it never becomes “down.” Use the monitoring dashboards for collector-confirmed health and SLA evaluation.

search.query: `ping_discovery_events($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | search record_type=discovery_scan_summary | search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | stats dc(scan_id) AS scans
`ping_discovery_inventory($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | stats count AS assets
`ping_discovery_inventory($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | where discovery_observed=1 | stats count AS observed
`ping_discovery_inventory($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | where discovery_observed=0 | stats count AS not_observed

`ping_discovery_inventory($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | search (evidence_status="$evidence_filter$" OR "$evidence_filter$"="*") | search endpoint_key="*$discovery_search$*" OR hostname="*$discovery_search$*" OR fqdn="*$discovery_search$*" OR target_ip="*$discovery_search$*" OR vendor="*$discovery_search$*" OR device="*$discovery_search$*" | eval fqdn=coalesce(fqdn, "Not resolved"), hostname=coalesce(hostname, "Unknown"), group=coalesce(group, "Unassigned"), dns_status=coalesce(dns_status, "unknown") | table endpoint_key, target_ip, hostname, fqdn, evidence_status, discovery_delta_status, dns_evidence, dns_status, discovery_latency_ms, target_network, group, entitytype, device, vendor, dev, monitoring_enabled, first_observed_human, last_observed_human, last_evidence_human, last_scan_id | rename endpoint_key AS "Endpoint ID", target_ip AS "IP Address", hostname AS "Hostname", fqdn AS "FQDN", evidence_status AS "Discovery Evidence", discovery_delta_status AS "Change", dns_evidence AS "DNS Evidence", dns_status AS "DNS Status", discovery_latency_ms AS "Discovery Latency (ms)", target_network AS "Scan Target", group AS "Group", entitytype AS "Entity Type", device AS "Device", vendor AS "Vendor", dev AS "Dev", monitoring_enabled AS "Monitoring Enabled", first_observed_human AS "First Observed", last_observed_human AS "Last Observed", last_evidence_human AS "Last Evidence", last_scan_id AS "Last Scan ID" | sort "Discovery Evidence", "IP Address"

`ping_discovery_events($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | search record_type=discovery_scan_summary | search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | eval completed=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), baseline=if(lower(tostring(baseline_available)) IN ("true","1","t"), "Compared with prior scan", "Initial baseline") | table completed, target_network, schedule_id, endpoints_observed, new_endpoints, missing_endpoints, unchanged_endpoints, scan_duration_ms, baseline, scan_id | rename completed AS "Completed", target_network AS "Scan Target", schedule_id AS "Schedule", endpoints_observed AS "Observed", new_endpoints AS "New", missing_endpoints AS "Not Observed", unchanged_endpoints AS "Unchanged", scan_duration_ms AS "Duration (ms)", baseline AS "Comparison", scan_id AS "Scan ID" | sort - "Completed"
`ping_discovery_inventory($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | stats count by dns_evidence
`ping_discovery_inventory($pm_index$, $pm_sourcetype$)` | search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | chart count over target_network by evidence_status
